definition: A tailorable technique of infusing YTTRIUM 90 (Y90) for hepatocellular carcinoma treatment with continuous restaging.
name: Radioembolization, Therapeutic

definition: An ORPHAN NUCLEAR RECEPTOR that is activated by farnesol metabolites in bile acid; Increases insulin production and sensitivity.
name: Receptor, Farnesoid X-Activated

definition: A tacrolimus binding protein with peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase activity that interacts with PROGESTERONE RECEPTOR complexes and HSP90 HEAT-SHOCK PROTEINS.
name: Tacrolimus Binding Protein 5

definition: A bacterial repressor protein that has serine endopeptidase activity. LexA represses transcription of genes involved in the SOS RESPONSE to DNA DAMAGE.
name: LexA Repressor Protein

definition: An inwardly-rectifying potassium channel that forms the pore of KATP CHANNELS. It regulates potassium permeability as a function of cytoplasmic ATP and ADP concentrations in many different cell types.
name: Kcnj11 Channel

definition: A basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor that regulates expression of genes in response to oxygen, including VASCULAR ENDOTHELIAL GROWTH FACTOR. It plays a role in the development of blood vessels (NEOVASCULARIZATION, PHYSIOLOGIC) and lung tissue.
name: Endothelial PAS Domain-Containing Protein 1

definition: A component of TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR AP-1; do not confuse with fibrinogen-related antigen (FRA antigen)
name: Fos-Related Antigen 1

definition: A dinucleoside triphosphate hydrolase that has a critical role in regulating the expression of genes essential for CELL PROLIFERATION; CELL SURVIVAL, and modulating APOPTOSIS.
name: Bis(5'-adenosyl)triphosphatase

definition: A protein that binds to certain BONE MORPHOGENIC PROTEINS to regulate their activity. In Xenopus embryos, this is a dorsalizing factor localized to the SPEMANN ORGANIZER. Mutations in this protein may occur in NOG-RELATED-SYMPHALANGISM SPECTRUM DISORDER.
name: Noggin Protein

definition: A cis-trans isomerase that catalyzes the isomerization of all trans-retinol to 11-cis-retinol (VITAMIN A) in the dark. It is expressed in the RETINAL PIGMENT EPITHELIUM and also converts ALL-TRANS-RETINYL ESTERS to 11-cis-retinol.
name: Retinoid Isomerohydrolase

definition: Phosphoric monoester hydrolases that dephosphorylate PHOSPHATIDYLINOSITOLS to regulate CELL SIGNALING.
name: Phosphoinositide 5-Phosphatases

definition: A serine-threonine protein kinase that functions in many different processes including the cellular response to PHYSIOLOGICAL STRESS, production of CYTOKINES; ENDOCYTOSIS; CYTOSKELETON dynamics, CELL MIGRATION; and CELL PROLIFERATION. It is phosphorylated by MAPK14 in response to stress, and in turn phosphorylates substrates at a SERINE that is preceded by a large hydrophobic amino acid.
name: MAP-Kinase-Activated Kinase 2

definition: An activation antigen and C-type lectin that is rapidly induced and phosphorylated after IL-2 stimulation of NK CELLS and a subset of low buoyant density T-LYMPHOCYTES.
name: CD69 Antigens

definition: Rab GTP-binding proteins that function primarily in regulating intracellular PROTEIN TRANSPORT among membrane-bound ORGANELLES and in ENDOCYTOSIS. They also participate in the establishment of CELL POLARITY in EPITHELIAL CELLS.
name: rab11 GTP-Binding Proteins

definition: A cytoplasmic autoantigen and ribonucleoprotein implicated in nascent RNA protection. It is a target of AUTOANTIBODIES in patients with SJOGREN'S SYNDROME.
name: SS-A Antigen

definition: A ubiquitin-protein ligase that supports INNATE IMMUNITY by binding to the invariant chain of antibody-virus complexes. It prevents expression of viral genes.
name: TRIM21 Protein

definition: A pathogen pattern recognition receptor and C-type lectin expressed on the surface of immature DENDRITIC CELLS (DCs). It also functions as a high-affinity receptor for intercellular adhesion molecules ICAM-2 and ICAM-3 to initiate the primary IMMUNE RESPONSE.
name: DC-Specific ICAM-3 Grabbing Nonintegrin

definition: An interferon regulatory factor that is key in immune CELL DIFFERENTIATION, LYMPHOCYTE ACTIVATION, and generating ANTIBODY-PRODUCING CELLS. They play a key role in the development of DENDRITIC CELLS.
name: Interferon Regulatory Factor-4

definition: An extracellular matrix protein that binds FIBRILLAR COLLAGENS and functions in CELL ADHESION; CELL MIGRATION; and CELL PROLIFERATION. In humans, the TGFBI gene encodes beta IG-H3 protein, and mutations in TGFBI cause CORNEAL DYSTROPHIES, HEREDITARY.
name: betaIG-H3 Protein

definition: An acetyltransferase that transfers an acetyl group to SPERMIDINE as it is converted into PUTRESCINE. It occurs in two types: the cytosolic N1-acetyltransferse (cSAT) and the nuclear N8-acetyltransferase (nSAT).
name: Diamine N-Acetyltransferase

aliases: Solute Carrier Family 16 (Monocarboxylic Acid Transporters), Member 1 Protein
definition: A bi-directional monocarboxylic acid transporter that occurs in many different tissues, including MYOCARDIUM; LYMPHOCYTES; and MONOCYTES. It catalyzes transport across the PLASMA MEMBRANE of monocarboxylates such as LACTATE; PYRUVATE; ACETATE; and KETONE BODIES.
name: Monocarboxylate Transport Protein 1

aliases: Solute Carrier Family 11- (Proton-Coupled Divalent Metal Ion Transporters), Member 2
definition: A cation transport protein that is important in metal transport, particularly iron, in MACROPHAGES. It is important in intestinal iron absorption and supplying iron for ERYTHROCYTES.
name: Solute Carrier Family 11, Member 2

definition: Monosaccharide transport proteins that move cytosolic URIDINE DIPHOSPHATE GALACTOSE into the Golgi apparatus by exchanging it for URIDINE MONOPHOSPHATE. They can also transport URIDINE DIPHOSPHATE N-ACETYLGALACTOSAMINE.
name: UDP-Galactose Translocators

definition: An atrial natriuretic factor receptor that regulates cardiac growth. It has a binding preference for NATRIURETIC PEPTIDE, C-TYPE.
name: Atrial Natriuretic Factor Receptor B

definition: An amino acid transport protein that acts as a SYMPORTER transporting taurine with sodium across the CELL MEMBRANE. It plays a role in the metabolism of NEUROTRANSMITTER AGENTS.
name: Taurine Transporters

definition: A member of the S100 family of calcium-binding proteins that binds BCL-XL PROTEIN. It acts as a PLASMINOGEN receptor that mediates plasminogen activation and is considered both a LIGAND for and a subunit of ANNEXIN A2.
name: S100 Calcium Binding Protein A10

definition: An extracellular matrix protein that interacts with proteoglycan monomers to form aggregate structures. It is involved in stabilizing the interaction between the proteoglycan subunit and HYALURONIC ACID in CARTILAGE.
name: Proteoglycan Link Protein

definition: A DNA helicase that performs EXCISION REPAIR functions following UV damage. In humans, mutations in the ERCC5 gene can cause XERODERMA PIGMENTOSUM, COMPLEMENTATION GROUP G and increase susceptibility to SKIN CANCER.
name: DNA Excision Repair Protein ERCC-5

definition: An RNA binding protein that binds to the HIV LONG TERMINAL REPEAT. An infected organism will produce it as RNA INTERFERENCE to prevent HIV from repressing host EIF-2 KINASE expression.
name: Trans-Activation Responsive RNA-Binding Protein

definition: Works about graphic visual representations of educational content.
name: Infographics as Topic

definition: An endodeoxyribonuclease that functions as part of a DNA TOPOISOMERASE II complex to create DOUBLE-STRAND DNA BREAKS for initiating HOMOLOGOUS RECOMBINATION in MEIOSIS.
name: Meiotic Recombination Protein SPO11

definition: A cell cycle protein required for activating TUMOR SUPPRESSOR PROTEIN P53 -mediated CASPASES and APOPTOSIS. It is up-regulated during colon epithelial cell differentiation and down-regulated in COLORECTAL NEOPLASMS.
name: N-myc Downstream-Regulated Gene 1 Protein

definition: Transcription factors that play a role in the development of NEURONS. They contain a homeodomain homologous to that of the Drosophila empty spiracles head gap gene product (ems).
name: Empty Spiracles Homeobox Proteins

definition: A homeodomain protein that plays a role in the proliferation and differentiation of HEMATOPOIETIC STEM CELLS. It is activated by TRETINOIN.
name: Homeobox A1 Protein

definition: A connexin which forms the structural component of GAP JUNCTIONS in the EYE LENS. In humans, variants in the GJA8 gene cause multiple types of CATARACT.
name: Connexin 50

definition: A homeodomain protein that influences the development and neuroprotection of DOPAMINERGIC NEURONS in the MESENCEPHALON. It is implicated in several types of cancer.
name: Engrailed 2 Protein

definition: A family of DNA polymerases that have the capability to carry out TRANSLESION DNA SYNTHESIS and have low replication fidelity on undamaged DNA.
name: Y-Family DNA Polymerases

definition: A serine endopeptidase that has a similar cleavage specificity to TRYPSIN, favoring substrates with poly-basic amino acid sequences. Prostasin plays a critical role in activating EPITHELIAL SODIUM CHANNELS through cleavage of the ENAC gamma subunit.
name: Prostasin

definition: Membrane and cytoskeletal-associated proteins that bind CALMODULIN and promote assembly of SPECTRIN and ACTIN FILAMENTS into MACROMOLECULAR PROTEIN COMPLEXES.
name: Adducins

definition: An oxidoreductase that metabolizes 10-formyltertahydrofolate into tetrahydrofolate.
name: Formyltetrahydrofolate Dehydrogenase
